Their hour.
Their space.
Their story.

Because what happens after the bell matters too.

GEMS Beyond the Bell gives children the space to explore their interests, discover new passions and build skills that stay with them beyond the classroom. From sports and performing arts to creativity, innovation, technology, life skills and entrepreneurship, every school brings its own opportunities to life.

One programme across GEMS India. Curated school by school.

Find it at your school Something for every child

One programme.
Different schools.
Different stories.

The proposition and identity remain consistent across GEMS India. What children experience can be different at every school.

Each school curates its own Beyond the Bell programme around the interests of its students, the facilities available on campus, and the coaches and partners it works with. Some schools offer specialist academies through approved partners, while others are led by our own coaches and teams.

The result is a programme that feels right for each school community, while remaining part of the wider GEMS experience.

Your school's page tells you what is available, when it runs, the fees and how to join.

Something for every child

From sports and performing arts to creativity, technology, innovation, life skills and entrepreneurship, Beyond the Bell gives children more opportunities to explore what interests them, discover new passions and grow beyond the classroom.

Learning, one module
at a time

Every activity follows a clear progression, so you always know what your child is working on next.

Expertly coached.
Thoughtfully supported.

Beyond the Bell academies may be led by approved specialist partners or by GEMS coaches and teams.

Whichever model a school uses, every experience sits within the GEMS ecosystem, with students supported and supervised by an After School Programme Coordinator until they are picked up.

Curated for
every school

Every GEMS school is different. So is its Beyond the Bell programme. Schools choose what to offer based on their students' interests, the spaces and facilities available, and the expertise and partnerships they can bring to the experience.
